newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline under pressure.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline under pressure.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday morning, with gas oil gaining late and gasoline under pressure, dealers said.
Gasoline barges were down by as much as $2 a tonne. One eurograde barge traded at $196 fob Rotterdam for the whole of May. First half May talk was at $194/$195 fob.
May swap quotes were uncertain. Offers were at $196.50 fob ARA, but bids were $2 lower.
Traders said the spread was likely to remain wide until physical barge levels were confirmed, but a move to the lower side seemed more likely.
"It looks like there are a number of people who want to shed material, particularly by first half (May)," one trader said.
Heating oil barges were barely changed for most of the early session, but received a firm boost by late morning as IPE gas oil futures gained $2 a tonne.
Premiums, however, were little changed. Offers were at IPE May +$1 fob Rotterdam. One barge traded at +75 cents.
Freight rates down the Rhine headed down as two days of rain finally lifted water levels. However, German demand remained poor.
"You just can't find any customers," one trader said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were unchanged from Monday after offers retreated from $83 to $82 fob Rotterdam.
Bunker demand showed no signs of improvement despite aggressive offers from suppliers. -- Philip Blenkinsop, Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5004
